data.name: Bharavi
data.gender_notes: Bharavi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bharavi is a name of the ancient Sanskrit poetess, revered for her profound works. She is said to be a goddess of poetry and the muse for artists and writers. The name Bharavi carries the meaning “Goddess of poetry” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bharavi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of poetry and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Bharavi belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of poetry.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bharavi total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

She is considered a pioneering figure in the Sanskrit literary world, influencing generations of poets and writers. Her works, filled with emotions, beauty, and depth, continue to captivate and inspire artists across genres and cultures.

Bharavi, then, is not just a historical or literary figure but a spiritual inspiration for her devotion to poetry and the arts, elevating her name to a sacred level.
